description: Defines static classes for predefined font family names and bullet characters used in MigraDoc document processing, including methods for initialization and resetting properties.

classes.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars
classes.description: Contains static properties and methods for font family names used for error messages, RTF info, and bullets in MigraDoc.

classes.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars.Bullets
classes.description: Nested static class defining font names and characters for bullet levels in MigraDoc documents.

methods.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars.Initialize
methods.description: Initializes default font names and bullet characters.

methods.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars.Reset
methods.description: Resets all properties to their initial default values.

methods.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars.Bullets.Initialize
methods.description: Initializes default font names and characters for bullet levels.

methods.name: PredefinedFontsAndChars.Bullets.Reset
methods.description: Resets bullet level properties to default values.
